statement.text:
For a fixed prime p does there exist a sequence of groups Pn of order
                                                                        √    pn such
that the number of conjugacy classes k(Pn ) satisfies limn→∞ log k(Pn )/ n = 0?
   Note that J. M. Riedl (J. Algebra, 218 (1999), 190–215) constructed p-groups for
which the above limit is 2 log p.                                         P. P. Pálfy
